results.title: TC-GEO-1184-001 - Most prompts sort orders the cards by descending prompt count
results.error: Wording only (D-2): expected "Sort by" to show "Failing articles" by default and "Most prompts" after selection; observed "Coverage" (default, description "Articles where your brand is not visible or perceived negatively") and "Prompts" (description "Prompts whose answers cite this source"). The sort itself is correct.

steps.title: Given the user opens the Action Center of the chosen analysis
steps.observed: "Sort by" control (aria-label/title "Sort by", data-testid actions-sort-dropdown) is in the page header left of the Card view / List view switch (sort x=983-1163, switch x=1179, same row) but shows "Coverage", not "Failing articles". Cards sorted by failing articles (42, 32, 32, 32, 22, 19, 19, 18, 17, 17, 17, 16) and each card shows "Used in N prompts".

steps.title: When the user opens "Sort by" and selects "Most prompts"
steps.observed: Menu options are "Coverage" and "Prompts" (no "Most prompts"). After selecting "Prompts" the list is re-sorted (API call sort=PROMPTS) and "Sort by" shows "Prompts". First attempt hit a transient 401 on target-sources?sort=PROMPTS (token refresh) and the UI silently stayed on Coverage; second attempt OK.

steps.title: Then the cards are in descending order of their prompt count
steps.observed: All 139 cards loaded (Show 127 more sources): prompt counts 156, 149, 135, 118, 107, 102, 98, 97, 92, 91, 90, 81 ... 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1; never increase. UI order = API target-sources?tab=ALL&sort=PROMPTS (139 sources, identical domain:promptCount sequence).

steps.title: And the ranks are renumbered from 1
steps.observed: Ranks 1..139 with no gap; rank 1 = largus.fr (156 prompts) instead of lefigaro.fr in Coverage order.

results.notes: Functional behaviour of AC-1 is correct; the FAIL is wording only (D-2 "Failing articles" / "Most prompts" vs UI "Coverage" / "Prompts"). Q-1: no "cited N× in gap answers" line on any of the 139 cards (only "Not visible in N articles", "Negative perception in N articles", "Used in N prompts"). D-3: subtitle shortened to "Sources to target to improve how AI engines represent your brand." (sort sentence removed).

results.title: TC-GEO-1184-005 - Ties of the Most prompts sort are broken by failing articles then domain

steps.observed: Option "Prompts" selected (label differs, see TC-001); 139 cards loaded, sorted by prompt count.

steps.title: When the user locates two cards with the same "Used in N prompts" value
steps.observed: 31 tie groups found, e.g. ranks 14-16 usnews.com, autoblog.com, cars.com all "Used in 80 prompts".

steps.title: Then the card with more failing articles comes first
steps.observed: 80 prompts: usnews.com 17 (15 not visible + 2 negative) > autoblog.com 9 > cars.com 7. Over the 31 groups, 51 adjacent tied pairs with different failing totals are all in descending failing order (0 violations).

steps.title: And cards tied on both counts are sorted by domain
steps.observed: 8 prompts + 1 failing article: best-selling-cars.com < bestsellingcarsblog.com < businessam.be < businessday.ng < ground.news (ranks 104-108). 25 adjacent pairs tied on both counts, all alphabetical (0 violations).

results.notes: Full list read in the UI (139 cards), failing = Not visible + Negative perception per card. Side observation (out of scope): a source domain displayed as "com.cn" (rank 117, 4 prompts, 3 failing articles) looks like a mis-parsed registrable domain.

findings.type: Design wording not followed (D-2) / CSV label
findings.text: Sort values are "Coverage" (default, description "Articles where your brand is not visible or perceived negatively") and "Prompts" ("Prompts whose answers cite this source") instead of "Failing articles" / "Most prompts" (GEO-1208 D-2; description of the default also differs from "Articles missing or negative about your brand"). Only cause of the 4 FAILs (001, 003, 007, 008).

List view "Prompts" header is a button (actions-table-prompts-sort-btn): clicking it while Sort by = Coverage switches the sort to Prompts; clicking it in Prompts mode keeps the order but resets the list to 10 rows. D-6 says header-click sorting is not part of this ticket.
No "cited N× in gap answers" line on any card; card lines = Not visible in N articles / Negative perception in N articles / Used in N prompts.
Prompt count follows both filters: country (France: 30/38 perception sources lower than All Countries) and AI engine (Perplexity only: largus.fr 87 vs 156).
A prompt cited by several engines counts once: elperiodico.com All (1) with ChatGPT (1) + Perplexity (1); API largus.fr 156 distinct vs 303 engine sum.

Q-4: export never follows the sort (PPTX slide 32 identical, XLSX 139 rows identical). OP-7: Prompts column stays in List view with Coverage. D-3: subtitle shortened to "Sources to target to improve how AI engines represent your brand."
Source domain displayed as "com.cn" (rank 117 in Prompts order, 4 prompts) - mis-parsed registrable domain.
